description: This file contains functions for rendering various UI components related to usage overview, including charts, filters, insights, and session management, for a web application using lit-html.

methods.name: pct
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of part over total, handling division by zero.

methods.name: getCostBreakdown
methods.description: Generates a detailed breakdown of usage costs and tokens from totals.

methods.name: renderFilterChips
methods.description: Renders UI chips for active filters with options to clear each filter.

methods.name: renderDailyChartCompact
methods.description: Renders a compact daily usage chart with bars representing tokens or costs.

methods.name: renderCostBreakdownCompact
methods.description: Displays a compact visual breakdown of usage costs or tokens by type.

methods.name: renderInsightList
methods.description: Displays a list of insights with a title and optional empty state.

methods.name: renderPeakErrorList
methods.description: Displays a list of peak error days or hours with optional styling.

methods.name: renderSummaryStat
methods.description: Renders a summary statistic card with title, value, subtext, and optional tone.

methods.name: renderUsageInsights
methods.description: Renders a comprehensive usage overview section with stats, top models, providers, tools, agents, channels, and error peaks.

methods.name: renderSessionsCard
methods.description: Displays a list of sessions with sorting, filtering, and selection capabilities.
